scope: Supports the two concrete feedback asks; supersedes the old broad remediation audit.

resources.qualification: Absence is scoped to the inspected Resources catalogue; existing Simon Strandgaard entries are not treated as missing.
resources.method: Read all catalogue entries and related links. Compared against ReferenceMaterial, Arc3Story, SyntheticLanding, shared ARC3 resources and selected Resource Hub entries. Normalize host/trailing slash, GitHub repo paths and arXiv abs/pdf versions; manually distinguish same-work alternatives and official resources from missing community resources.
resources.recheck: October 9: re-read the live catalogue bundle; none of the five community resources, nor the additional links, appear in it. ARC-AGI Puzzle Explorer (arc.markbarney.net/analytics) is listed first under Tools & Playgrounds.

public_games.observed_gap: Official page has play, model performance and replay controls; equivalent per-level commentary was not found.

synthetic_archive.check: Catalog API count and visible gallery category agree.

attempt_inspection.observation: Existing archive record has populated reasoning and predicted/expected grids. Official task table contains summary rows without individual attempt links. Archive combines official imports and community/local runs; do not assume equivalent coverage or settings.
attempt_inspection.record_check: October 9, live: record 73845 is claude-opus-4-6-thinking-120K-max-attempt1, incorrect on both test outputs; the expanded card shows pattern description, full reasoning, Predicted/Expected Output 1 and 2, and a Show Mismatches toggle.

publication.observation: ARC1/2 scores and task outcomes are published; all five ARC3 variants show a dash. No future publication commitment established.
publication.mark_account: Mark reports asking why raw-result publication stopped and being told he would hear back; no answer yet. Whether publication has ended is unconfirmed.

license.scope: ARC Explainer's own code, documentation and writing; third-party datasets, solvers, games and submodules keep their own licenses (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). package.json has declared MIT since the first commit on July 1, 2025.
